theVillagePreview.previewBadge: Muuqaal Khaas ah — Aan La Daabicin
theVillagePreview.previewBannerBody: Boggan si guud looma arki karo. Waa dhismo fikrad ah oo muujinaya sida boggii The Village Hargeisa ee Go Hargeisa u ekaan lahaa marka faahfaahinta ka hadhay lagu xaqiijiyo si toos ah ganacsiga. Magaca, goobta, lambarka taleefanka, iyo menu-ga oo dhammaystiran hoos ku qoran waa la xaqiijiyay si madax-bannaan; dhowr faahfaahin (saacadaha, sawirrada) weli waa la sugayaa — hoos ka eeg.
theVillagePreview.heroDescription: Maqaayad ku taal xaafadda Sha'ab ee Hargeisa. Goobta, lambarka taleefanka, iyo menu-ga oo dhammaystiran waa la xaqiijiyay; saacadaha shaqadu weli waxay sugayaan xaqiijin toos ah oo ka imaanaya ganacsiga.
theVillagePreview.verifiedNeighborhood: Xaafadda Sha'ab, u dhow Jaamacadda Alpha, Hargeisa, Somaliland
theVillagePreview.verifiedLocationNote: Goobta saxda ah waxaa lagu xaqiijiyay bogga rasmiga ah ee Google Maps ee ganacsiga — riix si aad u furto tilmaamaha.
theVillagePreview.verifiedPhoneNote: Waxaa si isku mid ah u xaqiijiyay 3 il oo madax-bannaan (Tripadvisor iyo laba bog oo Facebook ah).
theVillagePreview.verifiedLogoTitle: Sumaadda (logo) dhabta ah ayaa la xaqiijiyay
theVillagePreview.verifiedLogoNote: Sumaad joogto ah (calaamad line-art ah oo geeso leh + magac-qoraal) ayaa si isku mid ah uga muuqata akoonada Instagram-ka ee ganacsigan. Waxaa lagu muujiyey sare, oo si toos ah looga soo qaatay akoonkiisa rasmiga ah.
theVillagePreview.pendingHoursNote: Hal dalil ayaa sheegaya in adeegga uu ku koobnaado quraacda oo keliya (7:30–11:30 subaxnimo) — weli lama xaqiijin il kale, sidaa darteed halkan waxaa loo muujiyay sida qiyaas ah oo aan la xaqiijin.
theVillagePreview.pendingEmailNote: info@thevillagehargeisa.com wuxuu ka muuqdaa hal il — waxaa lagu sugayaa xaqiijin labaad ka hor inta aan la aaminin.
theVillagePreview.socialsNote: Labada akoon ee Instagram waxay wadaagaan sumaadda dhabta ah ee ganacsigan, iyo (iyada oo loo marayo bogagooda Facebook) lambarka taleefanka la xaqiijiyay — caddeyn wanaagsan oo muujinaysa in labaduba si dhab ah ula xiriiraan ganacsigan, in kastoo aan la go'aamin kan rasmiga ah ee kaliya.
theVillagePreview.experienceBody: Xuquuq uma lihin inaan soo dejino oo dib u martiyeeno sawirrada ganacsigan, sidaa darteed halkan waxaad ka arkaysaa dhig dhab ah oo toos uga socda akoonkiisa rasmiga ah ee Instagram — waxaana ku darsan xiriiro toos ah oo la xiriira labada akoon ee la xaqiijiyay wixii kale.
theVillagePreview.featuredPostCaption: Dhig dhab ah oo hadda socda oo ka socda akoonka rasmiga ah ee Instagram-ka The Village Hargeisa — si toos ah ayaa loo lifaaqay, lamana dib-u-martiyin.
theVillagePreview.finalCtaTitle: Ma diyaar u tahay inaad la kulanto The Village?
theVillagePreview.menuComingSoonBody: Ma helin menu guud oo la xaqiijiyay oo The Village Hargeisa. Marka lala xaqiijiyo ganacsiga, halkan ayuu ku soo bixi doonaa qaybo iyo qiimayaal dhab ah.
theVillagePreview.galleryComingSoonBody: Xuquuq nashqadeed uma lihin sawirrada internetka laga helay ee ganacsigan. Sawirro dhab ah ayaa halkan ka soo muuqan doona marka ganacsigu si toos ah noo siiyo.
theVillagePreview.conversionTitle: Tani waxay noqon kartaa boggaaga maqaayaddaada
theVillagePreview.conversionBody: Go Hargeisa waxay dhistaa boggag muuqaal sare oo la xaqiijiyay oo loogu talagalay iskaashatooyinka dhabta ah — menu, sawir-bandhig, dalabyo, qiimeyn iyo wax badan oo kale. Ganacsiyo dhab ah oo keliya, xogo dhab ah oo keliya.

joinRequest.trust2Description: Xogtaadu waa la ilaaliyaa marnaba lama wadaagayo.

joinRequest.trust4Description: Codso oo kooxdayadu way kula soo xidhiidhi doontaa si aad uga hadasho ikhtiyaarada iskaashiga ee jira.
joinRequest.faq1Answer: Codso ku biiristaada ganacsiga adigoo isticmaalaya Go Hargeisa. Kooxdayadu way eegi doontaa macluumaadkaaga oo kula soo xidhiidhi doontaa si aad uga hadasho ikhtiyaarada iskaashiga ee jira iyo qaabka ugu habboon ganacsigaaga.
joinRequest.faq2Question: Immisa ayay ku biiristu kuu kici doontaa?
joinRequest.faq2Answer: Go Hargeisa ma soo bandhigo qiimayaal go'an oo bogga codsiga ah. Kadib marka aad gudbiso codsigaaga, kooxdayadu way kula soo xidhiidhi doontaa si aad uga hadashaan ikhtiyaarada jira oo aad ku heshiiso qaabka ku habboon ganacsigaaga.
joinRequest.faq3Question: Maxaa dhacaya kadib markaan gudbiyo codsigayga?
joinRequest.faq3Answer: Kooxdayadu way eegi doontaa macluumaadka ganacsigaaga oo kula soo xidhiidhi doontaa si aad uga hadashaan tallaabooyinka xiga.
joinRequest.faq4Question: Ganacsi kasta ma ku biiri karaa?
joinRequest.faq4Answer: Go Hargeisa waxay taageertaa noocyo badan oo ganacsi, adeeg iyo goobo oo ku baahsan Hargeysa oo dhan. Codso oo kooxdayadu way eegi doontaa ganacsigaaga.
joinRequest.faq5Question: Goorma ayuu ganacsigaygu ka muuqan doonaa Go Hargeisa?
joinRequest.faq5Answer: Ganacsigaagu wuxuu soo baxi doonaa kadib marka codsiga la eego, la heshiiyo qaabka ku habboon, oo ganacsiga loo ogolaado in la soo bandhigo.

diasporaWeek.aboutTitle: Soo Laabasho Guri Oo loogu Talagalay Somaliland Kasta
diasporaWeek.aboutBody1: Toddobaadka Shatida Somaliland wuxuu wiilasha iyo gabdhaha wadanka ugu soo celiyaa Hargeysa — laga bilaabo Minneapolis ilaa London, Nairobi ilaa Dubai — shan maalmood oo ah is-xiriirin, wada-hadal iyo dabaaldeg. Waa wakhti ay isku dhawraan, ay wax-fikrado wadaagaan oo ay xaqiijiyaan aqoonsi wadareed.
diasporaWeek.aboutBody2: Mawduuca sanadkan, "Isku-duubka Gudaha ayaa Furaha u ah Aqoonsiga," wuxuu muujinayaa run fudud: midnimada gudaha ayaa aasaas u ah wax kasta oo kale ee la dhisayo. Iyadoo la adeegsanayo dabaaldegyo dhaqameed, munaasabado maalgashi, goleyaal dhalinyaro iyo kulamo bulsheed, Toddobaadka Shatida 2026 waxaa ujeeddadiisu tahay in aasaaskaas si wadajir ah loo dhiso.
diasporaWeek.infoTitle: Wax Walba oo Aad U Baahan Tahay Inaad Ogaato
diasporaWeek.infoSubtitle: Waxyaabaha ugu muhiimsan ee Toddobaadka Shatida Somaliland 2026, hal eeg ah.
diasporaWeek.infoDatesBody: Axad 2 Ogosto ilaa Khamiis 6 Ogosto 2026 — shan maalmood oo dhan oo barnaamij ah.
diasporaWeek.infoLocationBody: Hargeysa, caasimadda Somaliland, oo martigelinaysa goobo ka mid ah magaalada oo dhan.
diasporaWeek.infoThemeBody: "Isku-duubka Gudaha ayaa Furaha u ah Aqoonsiga" — midnimo ah aasaaska mustaqbalka wadanka.
diasporaWeek.infoAudienceTitle: Yaa U Baahan Inuu Ka Qeyb Qaato
diasporaWeek.infoAudienceBody: Somaliland kasta oo dibadda ku sugan, qoysaskooda, iyo saaxiibbada Somaliland meel kasta.
diasporaWeek.highlightsSubtitle: Barnaamij buuxa oo dhaqan, ganacsi iyo bulsho ah, oo furan booqdayaal oo dhan.
diasporaWeek.highlight1Body: Soo dhawaynta weyn ee furaysa Toddobaadka Shatida, oo isku keenaysa dawladda, hoggaamiyeyaasha bulshada iyo qoysaska soo laabtay.
diasporaWeek.highlight2Body: Ganacsatada shatida iyo ganacsiyada maxaliga ah ayaa is-aragga si ay u sahmiyaan iskaashi iyo fursado ku baahsan Somaliland oo dhan.
diasporaWeek.highlight3Body: Muusig, maansooyin, cunto iyo dhar dhaqameed oo ay ku dabaaldegayaan hodantinimada dhaqanka Somaliland.
diasporaWeek.highlight4Body: Dhalinyarada Somaliland ee guriga iyo dibadda ku sugan ayaa wadaagaya fikradaha ku saabsan tignoolajiyada, waxbarashada iyo jidka hore.
diasporaWeek.highlight5Body: Fiid dabaaldeg ah oo sharfaya wax-ku-biirinta ay shatida ku lahaayeen kobaca Somaliland.
diasporaWeek.highlight6Body: Wada-hadal furan oo ku saabsan isku-duubka gudaha — mawduuca ku dhex jira Toddobaadka Shatida sanadkan.
diasporaWeek.hotelsSubtitle: Deganaan raaxo leh oo u dhow dhacdooyinka — hore u ballansii, Hargeysa si dhaqso ah ayay ugu buuxsantaa Toddobaadka Shatida.

diasporaWeek.offersSubtitle: Dallacaado wakhti kooban ah oo ay bixiyaan lammaanayaasheena Hargeysa oo dhan.
diasporaWeek.tipsSubtitle: Waxyaabo aasaasi ah ka hor intaadan Hargeysa soo gaarin.
diasporaWeek.tip1Body: Inta badan booqdayaasha waxay heli karaan fiisa Somaliland marka ay yimaadaan Garoonka Diyaaradaha Ee Caalamiga ah ee Hargeysa (Egal) — hubi shuruudaha baasaboorkaaga ka hor intaadan safrin.
diasporaWeek.tip2Body: Shilinka Somaliland iyo doolarka Mareykanka labaduba si weyn ayaa loo aqbalaa; lacagta mobilada (Zaad, eDahab) ayaa ah habka ugu fudud ee lacag looga bixiyo maxaliga ah.
diasporaWeek.tip3Body: Taksiyada iyo gaadiidka hudheellada ayaa ah habka ugu wanaagsan ee lagu dhex socdo goobaha intii Toddobaadka Shatida socday.
diasporaWeek.tip4Body: Dhar fudud oo edeb leh oo maalmaha kulul, wax diirran oo fiidnimada loo baahan yahay, iyo kabo raaxo leh oo barnaamij buuxa.
diasporaWeek.faq1A: Waa isu-imaatin qaran oo shan maalmood ah oo Hargeysa lagu qabto oo soo dhaweynaya Somaliland ee adduunka oo dhan si ay ugu soo laabtaan dhaqan, maalgashi iyo wada-hadal, hoos ka socda mawduuca "Isku-duubka Gudaha ayaa Furaha u ah Aqoonsiga."
diasporaWeek.faq2A: Qof kastaa — Somaliland ee shatida ah, qoysaskooda, iyo qof kasta oo xiiseeya Somaliland ayaa lagu soo dhaweynayaa dhacdo kasta oo dadweynuhu ka qeyb galo.
diasporaWeek.faq3Q: Ma u baahan yahay fiisa si aan uga qeyb qaato?
diasporaWeek.faq3A: Inta badan booqdayaasha waxay heli karaan fiisa Somaliland marka ay yimaadaan garoonka diyaaradaha ee Hargeysa. Eeg qaybta Talooyinka Safarka ee kore iyo Hagaha Safarka oo buuxa faahfaahin ku saabsan baasaboorkaaga.
diasporaWeek.faq4A: Deganaanshuhu kuma jiro — laakiin qaybta Hudheellada Lagu Talinayo ee kore ayaa kuu fududaynaysa inaad ballansato hoy Hargeysa ah muddada toddobaadka.
diasporaWeek.faq5Q: Sideen ku qeyb-qaataa ama u sii ogaadaa wax badan?
diasporaWeek.faq5A: Nala soo xiriir bogga Xiriirka — kooxdeenu waxay ku tilmaami karaan dhacdada, goleyaha ama goobta saxda ah ee waxaad raadinayso.

about.title: Hargeysa Ka Dhigayna Mid Caqli Badan
about.heroSubtitle: Go Hargeisa waa madal dijitaal ah oo caqli badan oo isku xidha dadka deggan, booqdayaasha, shirkooyinka Soomaalida ee adduunka, iyo ganacsiyada maxalliga ah wax kasta oo magaaladu bixiso — meelaha, adeegyada, ganacsiyada, iyo waaya-aragnimada, dhammaantood meel keliya.
about.storyTitle: Loo Dhisay Hargeysa. Loo Dhisay Mustaqbalka.
about.paragraph1: Go Hargeisa waa <highlight>madal caqli badan oo daalacid iyo adeegyo</highlight> loo dhisay si loogu xidho dadka deggan, booqdayaasha, iyo shirkooyinka Soomaalida ee adduunka oo dhan wax kasta oo Hargeysa bixiso — meelaha, ganacsiyada, adeegyada, iyo waaya-aragnimada.
about.paragraph2: Waxaan la shaqeynaa hudheellada, maqaayadaha, adeegyada, iyo machadyada dhaqanka ee maxalliga ah si aan u hayno liistooyinkeena <highlight>sax ah, cusub, oo waxtar dhab ah leh</highlight>, hadday tahay inaad halkan deggan tahay, booqasho ku timid, ama aad raadinayso wax cusub oo kuu dhow.
about.paragraph3: Ma haysaa ganacsi aad rabto in la liistoyo, mise waxaad aragtay macluumaad aan la cusboonaysiin? Nala soo xiriir <link>bogga xiriirka</link> — waan ku faraxsanahay inaan ka maqalno.
about.storyStep1Body: Maxay u adkaatay in la helo macluumaad la isku halayn karo oo cusub oo ku saabsan booqashada Hargeysa? Waxaan go'aansanay inaan dhisno haga aan rabnay in uu jiro.
about.storyStep2Title: Waxaa Lagu Dhisay Codad Maxalli Ah
about.storyStep2Body: Liis kasta wuxuu ka dhashaa wadahadallo lala yeeshay milkiilayaasha hudheellada, maqaayadaha, iyo hagayaasha aqoonta u leh magaaladan.
about.storyStep3Body: Laga bilaabo booqdayaasha markii ugu horreysa ilaa shirkooyinka soo laabanaya guriga, Go Hargeisa wuxuu sii koraya inuu noqdo hagaha ugu dhammaystirnaan badan ee magaalada.
about.whyBuiltTitle: Sababtoo ah Hargeysa Waxay Mudan Tahay Wax Ka Fiican
about.whyBuiltBody: Sannado badan, helitaanka macluumaad la isku halayn karo oo ku saabsan Hargeysa waxay ahayd hadal-af, boostooyin la'eegin, ama si fudud oo aan la garanayn meesha la eego. Ganacsiyada maxalliga ahi ma haysan hab fudud oo ay ugu gaaraan dadka wax ka raadinaya, dadka deggan iyo booqdayaashuna ma haysan meel hal ah oo ay u jeestaan. Go Hargeisa waxaa loo dhisay si loo xidho farqigaas — mana aha xarunta liistooyinka oo fudud, waxaase ah madal dhab ah oo magaaladu ku kalsoon tahay.
about.visionTitle: Hargeysa Oo Ka Caqli Badan Oo Isku Xidhan
about.visionBody: Waxaan aragnaa Hargeysa halka ay ku dhici karto in qof kasta oo deggani helo wuxuu u baahan yahay ilbiriqsiyo gudahood, booqdayaal kastana ay dareemaan kalsooni intay sahminayaan magaalada, ganacsi kasta oo maxalli ahna — laga bilaabo kafateeriyo qoys leh ilaa hudheel sii koraya — uu leeyahay joogitaan dijitaal ah oo dhab ah oo xirfad leh. Go Hargeisa waa habka aan taas ku gaarno, liis kasta iyo xidhiidh kasta.
about.audienceResidentsBody: Raadi hudheellada, maqaayadaha, kafateeriyada, meelaha soo jiita, iyo adeegyada muhiimka ah ee magaalada — dhammaantood waa la xaqiijiyay oo waxay ku yaalaan meel keliya, waxaana lagu heli karaa Ingiriisi, Carabi iyo Soomaali.
about.audienceVisitorsTitle: Hargeysa, Diyaar Marka Aad Diyaar Tahay.
about.audienceVisitorsBody: Hadday tahay markaad markii ugu horreysa soo booqanayso ama aad guriga ku soo laabanayso dibad kadib sannado, Go Hargeisa wuxuu kaa caawiyaa inaad hesho meelo dhab ah, u qorshayso joogitaankaaga, oo dib ula xidhiidhdo magaalada kalsooni.
about.audienceBusinessTitle: Ganacsigaagu Wuxuu Mudan Yahay In La Ogaado.
about.audienceBusinessBody: Sii ganacsigaaga joogitaan xirfad leh oo ku saabsan Go Hargeisa — la xidhiidh dadka deggan, booqdayaasha, iyo shirkooyinka adduunka ee raadinaya waxa aad si sax ah u bixiso.
about.partnershipIdentityBody: Marka ganacsi noqdo lammaane rasmi ah oo Go Hargeisa ah, waxaa lagu aqoonsan yahay sumadda iskaashiga Go Hargeisa oo ku baahsan madasha oo dhan — calaamad cad oo u sheegaysa dadka deggan iyo booqdayaasha in ganacsigan la xaqiijiyay oo la aamini karo.
about.partnersTitle: Ganacsiyo Aan Ku Faraxsan Nahay Inaan La Shaqeyno
about.partnersSubtitle: Ganacsi kasta oo hoos ku yaal waa lammaane dhab ah oo la xaqiijiyay oo Go Hargeisa ah.
about.missionSubtitle: Afar ballan qaad oo qaabeeya wax kasta oo aan dhisno.
about.missionPromoteBody: Soo bandhigidda meelaha, dhaqanka, iyo martiqaadka Hargeysa dadka deggan, booqdayaasha, iyo shirkooyinka adduunka labadaba.
about.missionBusinessBody: Siinta hudheellada, maqaayadaha, iyo ganacsiyada maxalliga ah muuqashada ay mutaystaan, iyadoo aan la bixin kharash bilowga ah.
about.missionTrustBody: Liis kasta waxaa hubiya oo cusboonaysiiya kooxdeenna — ma jiro xog la soo ururiyay si aan sax ahayn, mana jiro qiyaas.
about.missionSmarterTitle: Hargeysa Ka Dhigidda Mid Caqli Badan
about.missionSmarterBody: U keenida qalab casri ah oo daalacid, xidhiidh, iyo buugsi ah magaalo mutaysata.
about.trustBody: Ganacsi kasta oo Go Hargeisa ku jira waxaa hubiya oo cusboonaysiiya kooxdeenna ka hor inta uusan soo baxin — sawiro dhab ah, macluumaad dhab ah, xog aan si toos ah loo soo ururin. Sidaas ayaan ugu hayaa madasha faa'iido dhab ah leh qof kasta oo isku halleeya.
about.howTitle: Baaro, La Xidhiidh, oo Buugee — Dhammaan Meel Keliya
about.howStep1Description: Raadi oo baaro hudheellada, maqaayadaha, kafateeriyada, meelaha soo jiita, iyo adeegyada magaalada Hargeysa.
about.howStep2Description: Arag sawiro dhab ah, faahfaahin, saacadaha shaqada, iyo goobaha khariidad falgal leh.
about.howStep3Description: Si toos ah ula xidhiidh ganacsiyada — wac, fariin ku dir WhatsApp, ama hel jihada.
about.howStep4Description: Buugee qol ama miis, ama si toos ah wax uga dalbo meesha ay ku jirto.
about.futureBody: Go Hargeisa wali wuxuu ku jiraa bilowga safarkiisa. Sida ay ganacsiyo badan u soo biirayaan oo dad deggan iyo booqdayaal badanina ku tiirsanaadaan madasha, waxaan sii wadi doonaa dhisidda qalabka magaaladan u baahan tahay — taxaddar, oo had iyo jeer ku salaysan waxa Hargeysa run ahaantii u baahan tahay xigga.

about.whyListingsBody: Hudheel kasta, maqaayad kasta, iyo meel soo jiita kasta ayaa la hubiyaa ka hor inta aan la daabicin.

about.whyMapsBody: Baaro magaalada si muuqaal ah adigoo isticmaalaya khariidado loo kooxeeyay qaybo.

privacy.intro: Go Hargeisa ("annaga") waxay ixtiraamtaa asturnaantaada. Siyaasaddan waxay khusaysaa boggan Go Hargeisa iyo abka mobilada (Android iyo iOS), kuwaas oo wadaaga isku akoon iyo xog — waxayna sharraxaysaa macluumaadka aan ururino iyo sida loo isticmaalo.

privacy.infoItem2: Faallooyinka, waxyaabaha la jecel yahay, safarrada la kaydiyay, iyo codsiyada buugsiga ee aad samaysid intaad gashan tahay.
privacy.infoItem3: Cinwaannada iimaylka ee ku biiray warsidaha.

privacy.useText: Waxaan macluumaadkaaga u isticmaalnaa oo keliya si aan u maamulno Go Hargeisa — u gaar yeelidda dashboard-kaaga, u dirista warsidaha aad ku biirtay, kugu ogeysiinta buugsigaaga, iyo ka jawaabidda foomka xiriirka. Xogta shakhsiga ah ma iibinno.
privacy.sharingText: Waxaan isticmaalnaa Supabase si aan u martigelinno database-kayaga, xaqiijinta, iyo kaydinta faylalka — xogta akoonkaaga iyo content-kaaga waxay ku jiraan iyaga oo ah kan xogta noo qabta, iyagoo leh amniga u gaarka ah. Haddii aad ku gasho "Sii wad adoo isticmaalaya Google", Google waxay maamushaa xaqiijintaas nagu magacayo waxayna nala wadaagaan magacaaga/iimaylkaaga si aad u oggolaatay. Xogtaada shakhsiga ah uma iibinno, uma kirayno, umana wadaagno xayaysiisyada ama dhinacyo kale.
privacy.retentionText: Waxaan haynaa xogta akoonkaaga inta uu akoonkaagu firfircoon yahay. Waxaad marwalba ka tirtiri kartaa akoonkaaga iyo dhammaan xogta la xiriirta (faallooyinka, waxyaabaha la jecel yahay, safarrada la kaydiyay) Settings-ka Akoonka ee dashboard-kaaga — uma baahnid inaad nala soo xiriirto. Waxaad sidoo kale noo codsan kartaa koobiga xogtaada ama inaan sixno adoo email u dirayo.
privacy.childrenText: Go Hargeisa uma talagalin carruurta ka yar 13 sano, mana ururino si ogsoonaan ah macluumaad shakhsi ah oo ka socda iyaga. Haddii aad rumaysan tahay in ilmo uu na siiyay macluumaad shakhsi ah, nala soo xiriir waanan tirtiri doonaa.
privacy.mobileText: Abka Go Hargeisa wuxuu codsadaa oo kaliya idmaanka uu u baahan yahay si uu u shaqeeyo: gelitaanka internetka, ogaanshaha xaaladda shabakadda (si loo muujiyo shaashadda 'internet ma jiro' marka loo baahdo), gaarsiinta ogeysiisyada (oo kaliya haddii aad shaqaysiiso), iyo gariirka (falcelinta interface-ka). Abku ma helo kaamerada, makarafoonka, xiriiryada, ama goobta saxda ah, kor u shubidda sawirrada (faallooyinka) waxay isticmaashaa xulashada sawirrada ee qalabkaaga halkii ay ka isticmaali lahaayeen idmaan si toos ah loogu siiyay abka.

terms.intro: Adigoo isticmaalaya boggan Go Hargeisa ama abka mobilada, waxaad ku oggolaataa shuruudaha soo socda. Fadlan si taxaddar leh u akhri.
terms.useOfContentText: Macluumaadka liistada (hudheellada, maqaayadaha, goobaha dalxiiska, dhacdooyinka) waxaa loo bixiyaa ujeeddooyin guud oo qorshaynta safarka ah. Qiimayaasha, saacadaha, iyo heli karista waa in lagu xaqiijiyaa si toos ah ganacsiga ka hor buugsiga.
terms.userAccountsText: Waxaad mas'uul ka tahay ilaalinta qarsoodiga xogta akoonkaaga iyo dhaqan kasta oo ka dhaca akoonkaaga. Faallooyinka aad soo gudbiso waa inay ahaadaan kuwo daacad ah oo ku salaysan khibrad dhab ah. Waa inaad si sharci ah u awoodo inaad heshiis ku xirmo si aad akoon u samaysato.
terms.bookingsText: Go Hargeisa waxay xiriirisaa dalxiisayaasha iyo hudheello, maqaayado, iyo ganacsiyo kale oo si madax-bannaan loo leeyahay. Ma nihin kuwa maamula ganacsiyahaas — codsiga buugsi ee lagu soo gudbiyo Go Hargeisa waa codsi loogu talagalay ganacsigaas, ma aha buugsi la xaqiijiyay annaga, ganacsigaas ayaa mas'uul ka ah bixinta. Marwalba ku xaqiiji faahfaahinta si toos ah ganacsiga.
terms.liabilityText: Go Hargeisa waxaa la bixiyaa "sida ay tahay" iyada oo aan la bixin dammaanad nooc kasta ah. Mas'uul kama nihin khasaaraha ka dhasha ku tiirsanaanta macluumaadka laga helo boggan ama abka, ama wax kasta oo ka dhasha xiriirkaaga ganacsi kasta oo la liistay.
terms.terminationText: Waxaan awood u leenahay inaan joojino ama xanibnno akoonnada ku xadgudba shuruudahan — oo ay ku jiraan faallooyin been ah, dhaqan xad-dhaaf ah, ama isku dayga in si xun loo isticmaalo nidaamka buugsiga. Waxaad marwalba ka tirtiri kartaa akoonkaaga Settings-ka Akoonka.
terms.governingLawText: Shuruudahan waxaa xukuma sharciyada khuseeya ee Somaliland, halkaas oo Go Hargeisa ka shaqeeyo.
terms.changesText: Waxaan mararka qaarkood cusboonaysiin karnaa shuruudahan; sii isticmaalka boggan ama abka ka dib isbeddel waxay macnaheedu tahay inaad aqbashay shuruudaha cusub. Isbeddellada muhiimka ah waxaa lagu muujin doonaa taariikhda "Markii ugu dambeysay ee la cusboonaysiiyay" ee kore.

travelGuide.visaBody: Dad badan ayaa heli kara fiisaha Somaliland marka ay ku soo gaaraan Garoonka Diyaaradaha ee Caalamiga ah ee Egal (HGA), ama horay uga hesho xafiiska matalaadda Somaliland ee dibadda. La socorso laba sawir oo baasaboor ah oo bixi lacagta dollar Mareykan ah.
travelGuide.airportBody: Garoonka Diyaaradaha ee Caalamiga ah ee Egal (HGA) wuxuu ka fog yahay ilaa 5 km bartamaha magaalada. Taksiyada iyo gaadiidka hudheellada ayaa laga heli karaa dibadda gelitaanka; kala heshii kirada intaadan bixin.
travelGuide.transportBody: Taksiyada la wadaago iyo kuwa gaarka ah ayaa ah habka ugu badan ee lagu socon karo magaalada. Aplikeeshannada gaariga raadinta ayaa xaddidan, sidaas darteed hudheelladu waxay diyaarin karaan darawallo la aamini karo oo loogu talagalay safarrada maalinlaha ah iyo geynta garoonka.
travelGuide.currencyBody: Shilinka Somaliland (SLSH) ayaa ah lacagta maxalliga ah, in kastoo dollarka Mareykanka si weyn loo aqbalo hudheellada, iibsiga waaweyn, iyo taksiyada. Lacagta mobilada (Zaad, eDahab) ayaa la isticmaalaa meel kasta, xitaa dukaammada yaryar.
travelGuide.safetyBody: Hargeysa guud ahaan waa ammaan booqdayaasha qaata taxaddarrada caadiga ah. Xidho dhar edeb leh, ka fogow in aad sawirto dhismayaasha dawladda ama millatariga, oo maxalli ahaan hubi tilmaamaha nabadgelyada ugu dambeeya safarka ka hor.
travelGuide.emergencyBody: Booliska: 999 · Isbitaalka Kooxda Hargeysa: waxaa laga heli karaa miiska soo dhaweynta hudheelka · Had iyo jeer wado cinwaanka iyo lambarka taleefanka hudheelkaaga.
travelGuide.internetBody: Kaararka SIM ee maxalliga ah (Telesom, Somtel) way jaban yihiin oo si fudud loogu iibsan karaa baasaboor. Daboolka xogtu wuu adag yahay bartamaha magaalada; inta badan hudheellada iyo kafateeriyaduba waxay sidoo kale bixiyaan WiFi.
travelGuide.customsBody: Somaliland waa bulsho Muslim ah oo dhaqameed. Xidho dhar edeb leh, ku salaam gacanta midig, kana filo in Jimcaha ay tahay maalin nasasho oo ganacsiyo badan.
travelGuide.bestTimeBody: Bisha Nofembar ilaa Febraayo ayaa bixisa cimilada ugu qaboow oo ugu raaxada badan. Xilliga roobabka (Abriil–Maajo) ayaa ka dhigi kara safarka magaalada dibadeeda mid adag.
travelGuide.packingBody: Dhar fudud oo edeb leh (waxaa lagula talinayaa gacmo dhaadheer iyo surwaal/goono dhaadheer), shaal haweenka, kabo lagu socon karo oo raaxo leh, ilaalin qorraxda, iyo kaydka koronto ee caalamiga ah.
travelGuide.faq1Q: Ma u baahanahay fiisa si aan u booqdo Hargeysa?
travelGuide.faq1A: Inta badan safarayaasha waxay heli karaan fiisaha Somaliland marka ay garoonka diyaaradaha yimaadaan, laakiin waxaa fiican in la hubiyo shuruudaha hadda jira ee jinsiyaddaada intaadan duulin.
travelGuide.faq2Q: Ma ammaan bay u tahay booqdayaasha Hargeysa?
travelGuide.faq2A: Hargeysa waxaa loo tixgeliyaa mid ka mid ah magaalooyinka ugu deggan oo ugu soo dhaweeya gobolka, laakiin sida meel kasta oo la booqdo, waxaa caqli gal ah in la sii socdo warbixinnada oo la qaato taxaddarro caqli gal ah.
travelGuide.faq3Q: Luqad noocee ah ayaa lagu hadlaa Hargeysa?
travelGuide.faq3A: Af-Soomaaliga ayaa ah luqadda ugu horreysa, iyadoo Carabiga iyo Ingiriisiga sidoo kale si weyn loo fahmo, gaar ahaan hudheellada iyo dadka da'da yar.

attractionsPage.emptyDescription: Waxaan hadda ku dari doonaa meelo soo jiita oo cajiib ah oo ka mid ah Hargeysa. Dib u soo booqo, ama baaro waxa kale ee magaaladu bixiso.

attractionsPage.whyVisitSubtitle: Magaalo adkaysi, martiqaad iyo sheekooyin sugaya in la ogaado.
attractionsPage.whyHistoryBody: Laga bilaabo Taallada MiG-ga ilaa waddooyinka wakhtiga gumeysiga, taallooyinka Hargeysa waxay sheegayaan safarka Somaliland ee xagga nabadda iyo madax-bannaanida.
attractionsPage.whyCultureBody: Ku raaxayso soo dhaweynta Soomaalida, suuqyada dhaqameed iyo bulsho hal-abuur leh oo ku xidhan boqolaal sano oo ganacsi iyo dhaqan ah.
attractionsPage.whySafetyBody: Somaliland waxaa loo yaqaan mid ka mid ah meelaha ugu ammaanka badan ee Geeska Afrika, dadkuna waxay ku faraxsan yihiin inay soo dhaweeyaan booqdayaasha.
attractionsPage.whyValueBody: Ku raaxayso khibrado, cunto iyo hoy dhab ah oo qarash yar marka loo eego meelaha kale ee la yaqaan.
attractionsPage.ctaTitle: Ma Diyaar u Tahay Inaad Baarto Hargeysa?
attractionsPage.ctaSubtitle: Qorshee joogitaankaaga oo baaro waxa magaaladu bixiso, laga bilaabo huteelada raaxada leh ilaa cuntooyinka aan la illoobi karin.

emaankooStorefront.aboutBody: Emaankoo Group waa shirkad khaas ah oo ganacsi elektaroonik iyo gaadiid ah oo u adeegta shakhsiyaadka iyo ganacsiyada Somaliland.
